Rules & FAQ

How do I join?

Press Join Discord at the top, accept the invite and read the rules channel.

What are the main rules?

Be kind, no hate or harassment, no spam or self-promo, keep NSFW out, and follow staff instructions.

How do I get roles?

Pick colors, pings and interest roles yourself in the roles channel.

How do I enter giveaways and contests?

Watch the events channel. Each post explains how to take part.

Can I request a song on the radio?

Yes, use the music channels and the custom bot to play what you want.

I need help from staff.

Ping a staff member or open a support request. We reply quickly.
